title: 6.29.2 Sub-build: Jump and take
description: Red jumps black: two squares diagonally, over the halfway square, and the piece jumped over is gone.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: Red sits in the corner with black one square up and to the right. Clicking red picks it up (into `picked`), but nothing can move yet.

steps.title: Two squares away
steps.instructions: After the `if` that picks red up, add `else if (picked && grid[r][c] === '' && abs(r - picked.r) === 2 && abs(c - picked.c) === 2) { }`: a click on an empty square two rows and two columns away. Leave the braces empty for now.
hints: `picked` is `null` until red is clicked, and `null` counts as false, so `picked &&` stops the test before `picked.r` is read.

steps.title: Over black, and take it
steps.instructions: Inside those braces, find the halfway square: `const mr = (r + picked.r) / 2;` and `const mc = (c + picked.c) / 2;`. Then, only `if (grid[mr][mc] === 'b')`: empty it with `grid[mr][mc] = '';`, put red on the new square with `grid[r][c] = 'r';`, empty red's old square with `grid[picked.r][picked.c] = '';`, and set `picked = null;`. Run: pick red up, click the square two up and two to the right, and black is gone.
hints: From row 3 to row 1, the square in between is row (3 + 1) / 2, which is 2.
Click two squares up and to the LEFT instead: that is off the board, so the click never lands there.

requirements.title: Two squares diagonally
requirements.description: A jump lands two rows and two columns away, tested with abs or another way. Help: 6.29.1 (Reading: Jumping over, and jumping again)

requirements.title: Black is on the halfway square
requirements.description: The square halfway between the two ends is worked out, and it must hold black. Help: 6.29.1 (Reading: Jumping over, and jumping again)

requirements.title: The jumped piece is taken
requirements.description: The halfway square is emptied, so black leaves the board. Help: 6.29.1 (Reading: Jumping over, and jumping again)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Sub-build: Jump and take". The task: with red picked up, a click on an empty square two rows and two columns away is a jump when the halfway square ((r1 + r2) / 2, (c1 + c2) / 2) holds 'b': that square is emptied and red moves to the new square. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries, nested ifs, switch statements and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.
